differences.native: MySQL obtains seconds with TIMESTAMPDIFF and naturally evaluates the hourly-rate division as noninteger arithmetic.
differences.app: SQLite subtracts strftime epoch seconds and uses 3600.0 to prevent integer division.
differences.rationale: SQLite lacks TIMESTAMPDIFF and its numeric affinity requires an explicit real operand here. The per-lot totals, ranking, car totals, rounding, join, and ordering are identical.
